name: Onedari Sweetie ~Koi no Oironashi wa Nando de~
original_name: おねだりSweetie～恋のお色直しは何度でも～
source:
Minakami Shuusuke is a cute guy, the kind that stimulates women's maternal instincts. He falls in love at first sight with his homeroom teacher, Ayase Yuzuha, and they start dating. Shuusuke's cousin, Fuyuko, is a popular cosplayer and so, she tries to introduce him to the world of cosplay, but he can't even pretend to be interested. When she hears about his girlfriend, Fuyuko comes up with a plan. She gives Shuusuke one of her outfits and tells him to make his girlfriend wear it. Now that she's got him cornered, he reluctantly agrees to do it. When alone with Yuzuha, he asks her to put on the outfit. Flustered, Yuzuha initially refuses. After some pleading, however, she gives in. The look on her face as he begged made his heart beat faster. But the embarrassment written on it after she changes into the outfit is even more exciting. He can't hold himself back anymore, so he pounces on Yuzuha and they have sex right then and there. That reminded Shuusuke just how fun it is to tease Yuzuha. Whenever he asks her to do something lewd and gets to see that flustered face of hers, he gets extra hard. Since that day, Shuusuke and Yuzuha are all about cosplay sex, and they don't even realize it was all Fuyuko's mischievous doing...

[Translated from [url=http://hadashi.product.co.jp/onedari/intro.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
水上周介是个可爱的家伙，是那种激发女性母性本能的家伙。他对班主任绫濑柚叶一见钟情，并开始约会。修介的表弟冬子是一位受欢迎的角色扮演者，因此她试图向他介绍角色扮演的世界，但他甚至无法假装感兴趣。当冬子听说他女朋友的事后，想出了一个计划。她给了周介一套她的衣服，并让他让他的女朋友穿上它。既然她把他逼到了绝境，他就勉强答应了。当与柚叶单独相处时，他要求她穿上这套衣服。柚叶一开始很慌张，拒绝了。然而，经过一番恳求，她屈服了。他恳求时她脸上的表情让他心跳加快。但换上这身衣服后，上面写的尴尬就更让人兴奋了。他再也无法克制住自己，于是他扑向柚叶，他们当场就发生了性关系。这让修介想起了捉弄柚叶是多么有趣的事情。每当他要求她做一些猥亵的事情并看到她那张慌乱的脸时，他就会变得格外严厉。从那天起，修介和柚叶就热衷于角色扮演性爱，他们甚至没有意识到这都是冬子的恶作剧……
